name: Pinkfong! Dinosaur Songs
overview: Shake it! Shake it! Sing and move your body with awesome dinosaurs and learn their names. Meet Pinkfong's fun, educational videos that captured the hearts of millions of children around the world. Enjoy hundreds of kids' favorite songs and stories created by Pinkfong, the official creator of global hit Baby Shark behind #BabySharkChallenge.
